titulo_fr: Les sons dans les mots : Repérer les informations
titulo_es: Frequent graphics and sounds: Find data
intro: Read frequent combinations and silent endings in known words. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Read frequent combinations and silent endings in known words. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.

Attention point: Ou, oi and au / eau have frequent correspondences; ai pronunciation varies according to the word; many final consonants are mute, with exceptions. In this fragment, «bonjour» means «Hello.».
